selection: per-seed best validation MAE, early stop; final generation per-seed by same validation only; test used once after freeze
training: new generations accumulated, full shuffled epochs, each game equal loss mass; old data <=10% examples, unique new games counted separately
generation_policy: half-point selfplay plus gen4/prior/ridge, depth4 cap150ms; policy top16/random legal diverse prefixes; same deterministic selfplay seat-swaps not generated
comparison: 128 fresh prefixes x 2 seats x 3 opponents =768; plus 18 standard games. 500ms width4 depth6 all players; no test-driven retraining
split: fixed independent prefix seeds; remove whole validation/test group on overlap; training excludes reserved prefix states and known old validation/test positions; duplicate traces never independently counted
stop: 24h, nonfinite, resource failure; resume with atomic game/checkpoint identity
